title: 7.8.2: Key Equations
originalText:
Key Equations

            Pythagorean Identities	
            \(\begin{matrix}{sin}^{2}θ+{cos}^{2}θ=1\\1+{cot}^{2}θ={csc}^{2}θ\\1+{tan}^{2}θ={sec}^{2}θ\end{matrix}\)	

            Even-odd identities	
            \(\begin{matrix}tan(−θ)=−tan θ\\cot(−θ)=−cot θ\\sin(−θ)=−sin θ\\csc(−θ)=−csc θ\\cos(−θ)=cos θ\\sec(−θ)=sec θ\end{matrix}\)	

            Reciprocal identities	
            \(\begin{matrix}sin θ=\frac{1}{csc θ}\\cos θ=\frac{1}{sec θ}\\tan θ=\frac{1}{cot θ}\\csc θ=\frac{1}{sin θ}\\sec θ=\frac{1}{cos θ}\\cot θ=\frac{1}{tan θ}\end{matrix}\)	

            Quotient identities	
            \(\begin{matrix}\\tan θ=\frac{sin θ}{cos θ}\\cot θ=\frac{cos θ}{sin θ}\end{matrix}\)	

            Sum Formula for Cosine	
            \(cos(α+β)=cos α cos β−sin αsin β\)	

            Difference Formula for Cosine	
            \(cos(α−β)=cos α cos β+sin α sin β\)	

            Sum Formula for Sine	
            \(sin(α+β)=sin α cos β+cos α sin β\)	

            Difference Formula for Sine	
            \(sin(α−β)=sin α cos β−cos α sin β\)	

            Sum Formula for Tangent	
            \(tan(α+β)=\frac{tan α+tan β}{1−tan α tan β}\)	

            Difference Formula for Tangent	
            \(tan(α−β)=\frac{tan α−tan β}{1+tan α tan β}\)	

            Cofunction identities	
            \(\begin{matrix}sin θ=cos(\frac{π}{2}−θ)\\cos θ=sin(\frac{π}{2}−θ)\\tan θ=cot(\frac{π}{2}−θ)\\cot θ=tan(\frac{π}{2}−θ)\\sec θ=csc(\frac{π}{2}−θ)\\csc θ=sec(\frac{π}{2}−θ)\end{matrix}\)	

            Double-angle formulas	
            \(\begin{matrix}sin(2θ)=2sin θ cos θ\\cos(2θ)={cos}^{2}θ−{sin}^{2}θ\\=1−2{sin}^{2}θ\\=2{cos}^{2}θ−1\\tan(2θ)=\frac{2tan θ}{1−{tan}^{2}θ}\end{matrix}\)	

            Reduction formulas	
            \(\begin{matrix}{sin}^{2}θ=\frac{1−cos(2θ)}{2}\\{cos}^{2}θ=\frac{1+cos(2θ)}{2}\\{tan}^{2}θ=\frac{1−cos(2θ)}{1+cos(2θ)}\end{matrix}\)	

            Half-angle formulas	
            \(\begin{matrix}sin \frac{α}{2}=±\sqrt{\frac{1−cos α}{2}}\\cos \frac{α}{2}=±\sqrt{\frac{1+cos α}{2}}\\tan \frac{α}{2}=±\sqrt{\frac{1−cos α}{1+cos α}}\\=\frac{sin α}{1+cos α}\\=\frac{1−cos α}{sin α}\end{matrix}\)	

            Product-to-sum Formulas	
            \(\begin{matrix}\\cos α cos β=\frac{1}{2}[cos(α−β)+cos(α+β)]\\sin α cos β=\frac{1}{2}[sin(α+β)+sin(α−β)]\\sin α sin β=\frac{1}{2}[cos(α−β)−cos(α+β)]\\cos α sin β=\frac{1}{2}[sin(α+β)−sin(α−β)]\end{matrix}\)	

            Sum-to-product Formulas	
            \(\begin{matrix}\\sin α+sin β=2 sin(\frac{α+β}{2})cos(\frac{α−β}{2})\\sin α−sin β=2 sin(\frac{α−β}{2})cos(\frac{α+β}{2})\\cos α−cos β=−2 sin(\frac{α+β}{2})sin(\frac{α−β}{2})\\cos α+cos β=2 cos(\frac{α+β}{2})cos(\frac{α−β}{2})\end{matrix}\)	

            Standard form of sinusoidal equation	
            \(y=A sin(Bt−C)+D or y=A cos(Bt−C)+D\)	

            Simple harmonic motion	
            \(d=a cos(ωt)ord=a sin(ωt)\)	

            Damped harmonic motion	
            \(f(t)=a{e}^{−c}{}^{t}sin(ωt) or f(t)=a{e}^{−ct}cos(ωt)\)
